g.text: Every restart and giving up: a watchdog line in .logs/gateway.log, and
a Telegram message if the Telegram secrets exist; after a restart a
second one when the controller is ready again. One watchdog at a time.

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

g.text: Development flag: every restart waits for
Enter at the terminal (tmux attach -t voice).
requested by voice, after a yes:
at once, not counted as a crash
